text: Khargol gro-Boguk is an Orsimer barbarian who prefers a solitary existence, living alone in an otherwise Vacant Tower on the outskirts of Dagon Fel, Morrowind.
Khamuzi is a Khajiit slave who resides in Molag Mar, Morrowind. She can be found across the city's plaza from the Temple.
Khinjarsi is a Khajiit Slave working in Desele's House of Earthly Delights, in Suran. She serves drinks to anyone who comes into the club.
Kiara is a Redguard ostler in . She spends most days wandering around the city of Anvil and so she can be found in and around Anvil. She often rests in the Brina Cross Inn.

Kiliban Nyrandil is the Dunmer sorcerer, and the caretaker of the Xedilian. He will help by giving the Hero instructions found in the Manual of Xedilian if it was not read when it was given to them by Sheogorath.
Kharjo is a Khajiit warrior found traveling alongside Ahkari. He, along with Dro'marash, works as a guard protecting Ahkari and Zaynabi.

Khayla is a Khajiit guard traveling with the Khajiit Caravans. She can be found traveling with Ri'saad on his caravan. She serves as a guard, protecting Ri'saad, Atahbah, and Ma'randru-jo in their travels throughout Skyrim. She is an Adept level Trainer for the Sneak Skill.
Kharag gro-Shurkul is an Orsimer lumberjack, who resides at the Solitude Sawmill. He works for Hjorunn, and comments on how Hjorunn treats him as an equal, unlike most people in town.
Kind Erushara is a Dunmer residing in Maar Gan. He works as a miner, and wields a Miner's Pick as a result.
Kharzug gra-Gat is an Orsimer Warrior residing in Valenvaryon.
King Renwic was the Breton ruler of Betnikh at the time of the Orc invasion that conquered the island.
Khasha was a member of the Penitus Oculatus during Titus Mede's reign.
King Demog is Goblin and the leader of the Dogeater Tribe. He and his tribesmen have killed Gugnir's brothers and they might be planning an attack on Port Hunding according to him.
Khari is a Khajiit who has been taken hostage by the Crosstree Bandits, a group of Skooma dealers established in Hazak's Hollow. He is later revealed to be the son of their leader, Hazak.

King Casimir was the Breton king of the city-state of Daggerfall in Glenumbra during the year 582 of the Second Era. The Bloodthorn Cult plotted to assassinate him, before the Vestige intervened and foiled the assassination attempt in Casimir's own palace.

Khali is a Khajiit in who is one of the current Lunar Champions, along with her twin sister Shazah. They are both next in line to become the Mane of the Khajiiti people following the demise of Akkhuz-ri. Compared to her sister, Khali is more adventurous and pragmatic and also more prone to seek revenge. This is seen multiple times during her journey down the Moonlith Path. In the end, if Shazah is chosen as the next Mane, Khali will be corrupted by the Dark Mane and will need to be put down.
Khalama is a Khajiit Bard found at her caravan south of the Laughing Moons Plantation.
Khana is a Khajiit commoner found at the Temple of Two-Moons Dance.
Khash-Ti Dhrur is a unique dremora lord found in the Citadel of Myn Dhrur inside the Daedric Ruins of Norenen-dur far beneath Mournhold's Plaza Brindisi Dorom.
Khunzum is a Khajiit mystic and member of the Baandari Clan. He sells his wares at his stall, Khunzum's Curiosities, at their caravan settled in Kozanset.
Khosren al-Bergama is a Redguard beggar and patron of Anchor's Point Inn, residing in the city of Evermore.
Khalisah is a Redguard residing in the town of Hoarfrost Downs.
Khemd is a Redguard member of the Bloody Fists found in Port Hunding.
Khalajo is a Khajiit magus and a member of the Mages Guild. She is found at their branch in Shor's Stone.
Khalima is a Khajiit member of the Mages Guild. She is found at their branch in Marbruk.
Khanni is a Khajiit spirit trapped within an Ayleid contraption found inside Abamath.
Khara-ko is a Khajiit member of the Mages Guild. She is found at their branch at the Martyr's Crossing.
Kharg of the Stone is an Orsimer warrior of the Iron Orcs clan. He may be found in the Valley of Scars, Craglorn.
Kharg is an Orsimer guild trader who sells his wares at his kiosk, Kharg's Cart, at the Valeguard Wayshrine in Malabal Tor.
Kharsh is an Orsimer member of the Seamount Clan found in the Stonetooth Fortress.
Khasar-dro is a Khajiit member of the Renrijra Maor. He is part of the group that attacked Murkwater.
Khizuna is a Khajiit member of the Mages Guild. She is the magister of their branch in Jorunn's Stand.
Khralek gro-Vortag is a powerful Orsimer warrior of the Oathbound Clan residing in Malak's Maw.
Kigum-dar is a Khajiit chef. He sells his wares at his stall, Delicious Delights, at the stalls of the Redfur Trading Post.

King Aphren is a Breton spirit found in his tomb in Stormhaven. In life he was a member of the Gardner Dynasty, and had the original Wayrest Palace built. He conquered Wind Keep and named the stronghold Aphren's Hold.
King Donel Deleyn is a Breton spirit found at the Burial Mounds, Glenumbra, in . He was the King of Daggerfall from 2E 342 to 401.
King Xakhwan is a Yokudan king of the Ra Gada encountered in a vision of the past during the Ash'abah initiation. He is the father of Prince Sameer and Prince Haqmir.
Kiika is a cat who can be seen running around outside The Boatman's Tail in the port city of Mistral, in Khenarthi's Roost.
Khemzarq is a Redguard member of the Mages Guild residing in the city of Mournhold.
Kiasha is a Khajiit farmer residing in the city of Orsinium, located in its market, Haggler's Bluff. She has no unique dialogue.

King-Chief Edu is a powerful unique Riekr who has been leading the Wrothgarian goblin tribes in raids involving the plundering of cargo and capture of civilians. He can be found at the King-Chief's Throne, north of Orsinium, and will be commanded hordes of Riekr, Durzog, and Ogres against any attackers. Once a few waves are defeated, Edu himself will enter the battle.
Khubzyat is a Redguard residing in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.

Khartag was a well-known Orcish warrior that served as an ex-member of the Daggerfall Covenant and the leader of the Ropefish, an abolitionist group that helped slaves escape the Great House Telvanni in Vvardenfell.
Khorajah is a Redguard member of the Horsemen found at Silverhoof Vale in Rivenspire.
Khudriran is a Redguard alchemist residing in the Craglorn city of Belkarth within the Belkarth Bazaar marketplace. He has no unique dialogue.
Khambua is a Redguard laborer residing in the Warehouse District in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
King Barynia was a Breton and King of Wayrest during the Fourth Era.
Kiliban Arethi is a Dunmer member of the Clockwork Apostles found at the Clockwork Basilica in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City. __NOTOC__
Kianra Elsinor is a librarian of Mages Guild. In , she gives a player the Mages Guild quests.
Khuhari is a Khajiit who can be found in the Illumination Academy in Summerset. She cannot be interacted with.
Khamira is a Khajiit aide to the speaker of the Mane, Lord Gharesh-ri and secret heir to the throne of Anequina in .
King Narilmor is the ancient Ayleid ruler of Garlas Malatar.
Kinaro is a Khajiit found at Greenleaf Farm in Northern Elsweyr. He is Tsazii's husband and will explain to the Vestige that Tsazii's brother Hursh was recently killed by Euraxia's soldiers.
Khilena-ka is a Khajiit dancing for Skalf in The Sugar Bowl in the city of Rimmen, Northern Elsweyr. She has no unique dialogue.
Khajiit Peasant is a Khajiit sweeping the porch of a house in the city of Rimmen, Northern Elsweyr. He has no unique dialogue.
King Zirik is a Dunmer residing in the palace of the city-state of Mournhold in Morrowind, serving as its king.
King Erarne is the ruler of Winterhold, Skyrim during the events of . His rival is Lord Tobar.
Khasda Deadeyes are Khajiit archers found in Meirvale Keep in Northern Elsweyr. They are employed by Khasda to defend the keep and are always hostile towards the Vestige.

Khunzar-ri; known as Zar for short as well as The Laughing Lion, Luminous Lion of Elsweyr, Jonelight Jaunter, and Imprisoner of Dragons; was a mythic Khajiit hero and warrior active during the Merethic Era.
Kimbrudhil the Songbird is a Nereid found in the Shipwreck Cove in .
King Hemakar is a Khajiit mummy located in the courtyard of Rimmen Palace, Rimmen, Northern Elsweyr, during the quest "Two Queens" in .
Khajiiti Recruits are generic Khajiit in . They accompany the Vestige during Demonstration quests for the Elsweyr Defense Force, learning from them how to fight various creatures across Tamriel.
Kintyra Septim II was the eighth monarch and second Empress regnant of the Third Empire of Tamriel.
Kintyra Septim was the third monarch of the Third Era and first Empress to rule Tamriel.

Kithlan is a Redguard noble who resides in the Shivering Isles and is Syl's Steward. In the quest "Ritual of Dementia," he can be convinced to give the key to the Private Gardens and Syl's room to the Hero.
Kishashi is a Khajiit commoner who works at Cindanwe's farm in Fellmoor. According to dialogue, she claims to have once been the queen of the Shivering Isles.
Kjeld is a Nord smith who resides in Druscashti Ruins ruins near Khuul, Morrowind. He is a servant member of the Quarra vampire clan who is hostile towards non-members, attacking on sight.
Knurguri is a Nord vampire who resides in Druscashti in the Ashlands of Morrowind.
Konahrik (Dragon Language: , "Warlord") is one of ten powerful dragon priest masks found in .

Kodlak Whitemane is the Harbinger of the Companions in who resides in Whiterun. As Harbinger, he does not give orders, but his word is highly respected in Jorrvaskr and across all nine Holds of Skyrim. Kodlak is also a member of The Circle, though he wishes to be rid of his lycanthropy, since upon death, a werewolf's soul goes to the Daedric Prince Hircine's hunting grounds. Kodlak does not wish for this to be his fate and instead wants his soul to go to Sovngarde, the Nordic afterlife. If the Companions questline is completed, the Dragonborn becomes Harbinger and cleanses Kodlak of his Lycanthropy. He can later be seen in Sovngarde among the other lost spirits that are trapped in the mist f

Klimmek is a Nord trader in who resides at his house in the town of Ivarstead. He can be found on the road out of Ivarstead to High Hrothgar on various occasions. He works as a fisherman together with Bassianus Axius, who has a key to the house, and is currently searching for a job and a permanent residence in Ivarstead.

Kleppr is a Nord citizen in the city of Markarth. He can be found working at the Silver-Blood Inn, which he operates with his wife, Frabbi, who he is constantly bickering with. Their children, Hroki and Hreinn, also work at the inn.
Knud is a Nord child found at Katla's Farm outside Solitude.

Kjeld the Younger is a Nord miner who lives in Kynesgrove. He is the son of Kjeld and Iddra. He is not to be confused with his father, who runs the Steamscorch Mine and the settlement of Kynesgrove itself.
Knjakr is an insane Elder Nord cannibal who can be found hidden away in the Ratway Warrens deep beneath Riften.
Koniinge is a character mentioned in the Charwich-Koniinge Letters. He is searching for Azura's Star.
Kluwe, who went by Loate when hiding his face, was an Atmoran warrior who lived during the Merethic Era. He was one of the Five Hundred Companions.
Kirsten is a Nord merchant and innkeeper in the village of Bleaker's Way north of the Imperial City.
Kjoric the White was a former High King of Skyrim, during the First Era.
Kitbael Assurnumanit is a Dunmer barbarian who resides at the Yakaridan Camp in the Grazelands of Morrowind.
Koffutto Gilgar is a hostile Orsimer found guarding the Gimothran Ancestral Tomb, along with five undead creatures.

Knight-Paladin Gelebor is one of the last known Snow Elves alongside his brother, Arch-Curate Vyrthur, in . He has served as a sentinel and Knight-Paladin at the Chantry of Auri-El for thousands of years.
Kjolver is a Nord commoner living in her dwelling on the Isinfier Plains, in the center of the island of Solstheim. She shares her house with her husband, Brandr.

Kiseena is a Khajiit Slave residing in Slave Shack One at Caldera Mining Company in the West Gash region of Morrowind. She has lately sustained a grave burn through an explosion caused by a mage's fire spell interacting with flammable gases deep in the mine.
Kolfinna is a Nord commoner living in her dwelling, a cave located on the Isinfier Plains close to the Iggnir River, east of Raven Rock.
Kirginia is a Redguard warrior who resides in the cave of Punsabanit. She has no unique dialog and offers no services.
Kisisa is a Khajiit slave who resides in the Arena of Rotheran.
Kip Orinth is a Breton and a former member of the Red Rook Bandits. He is held captive by the Lion Guard at their camp near the ruins of Dwynnarth.
Kiturr is a Khajiit beggar working at the dockyards of Davon's Watch.
Kireth Vanos is a Dunmer dungeon explorer, along with her brother, Raynor. Both can be found inside various ruins across Tamriel.
Knutrida is a Nord member of the Mages Guild. She is found on Eyevea.
Knarstygg is a retired Nord adventurer found at the Dro-Dara Plantation.
Klang is an Orsimer residing at his manor in the city of Wayrest, Stormhaven.
Kinhassur is a Dunmer Ashlander member of the Mabrigash Tribe. She is found at their village located in the Vale of the Ghost Snake.
Kinlady Iniel is an Altmer leader of the Corelanya Clan, who opposed the Ra Gada's claim to the Alik'r.
Kirai-la is a Khajiit moon priestess. She is one of the few who survived the Stonefire Cult attack on the Do'Krin Monastery.
Kirk Ellioni is a Breton merchant found at the Shornhelm City Guard camp found at the base of The Doomcrag.
Kirun is a Khajiit forge worker and Smith found in Mathiisen in the region of Auridon.
Klaandi Steel-Fist is a Nord clothier. He sells his wares at his stall, The Steel-Clad Fist, at the Riverside Markets in Stormhold.
Klovag is an Orsimer residing in the town of Vlastarus, Cyrodiil.
Knight Commander Cheryline is a Breton and the current leader of the Knights of Saint Pelin. She is found at their camp at the Martyr's Crossing.
Klause is a mad Nord found inside the ruins of Shada's Tear.
Knapper is a dog that appears in the Cyrodilic township of Weye.
Knavus Tharn was a member of House Tharn and the great grandfather of Abnur Tharn. Little is known about him, and he is only mentioned during the quest "Valley of Blades."
Koeglin Deputy is a Breton guard residing in Koeglin Village, Stormhaven.
Knuckle-Bones is an Argonian found at the docks in Anvil, The Gold Coast. She can be seen playing dice with Ubra and Lucky Gurg. She is a lackey of Dockmaster Qamar.

Kor is a Nord assassin member of the Dark Brotherhood. He is found at their sanctuary on the Gold Coast. Kor is the one responsible for Hildegard joining the Brotherhood. Acting as her only friend and protector, he brought her to the sanctuary to keep her from causing harm to herself and others due to her lycanthropy.
Knight Commander Panthius is an Imperial member of the Order of the Hour. He is the current grand champion of the Kvatch Arena.
Klankaatu is an Argonian member of the Ebonheart Pact stationed at Fort Virak.
Knight of the Dragon is a generic Breton residing in Glenumbra.
Knave of Rooks is a Crow found in the Crow's Wood. Knave of Rooks is a member of Blackfeather Court.
Klaandor is a Nord member of the Ternion Monks found in Mistwatch.
Kizmar is a character residing in Tel Aruhn, in Vvardenfell.
Kohnu is a character who appears in . He was an Umbrielian working in Toel's kitchen.
Kloavdra is a hagraven, leader of Crow-Wife Clan, who lived in the mountains north of Evermore in High Rock. The clan was known to take slaves and worship Daedra, most notably Namira.

Kinlady Avinisse is the Altmer Kinlady of the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. A harsh critic of the island's newly opened borders, she can initially be found in her mansion's garden during the quest "The Queen's Decree."
Kinlady Turquenwen is an Altmer kinlady encountered in the wilderness of Summerset.
Kirgut is an Orsimer drunkard residing with her clan beneath Exile's Barrow. He has no unique dialogue.
Kinlady Ilunsare is an Altmer highborn Kinlady residing in the Summerset Isles on the beach south of the Sunhold Wayshrine.
Klor is an argonian member of the Bright-Throat Tribe found near the Glade of Chimes. He is betrothed to Beehuna.
Knight of Saint Pelin is a generic Breton member of the Knights of Saint Pelin. They are found in their camp at the Martyr's Crossing. They cannot be interacted with.
Klutsaan is an Argonian member of the Root-House Tribe found at the Glade of Chimes in Bright-Throat Village, Murkmire.
Kjalnar's Nightmare is a monster set in . It is based on Tzirzhalir from Unhallowed Grave.

King Klaius was the father of Queen Mynisera. While he was prince, he and Lysandus laid siege to an Orcish settlement. After defeating the warriors, he ordered those remaining killed. Consisting of only the sick, elderly and children and despite their desperate pleas to spare them, he insisted that they would grow up to be strong and hearty and only an unwise leader would show mercy to "subhumans". The soldiers then proceeded to hunt down the survivors for sport, much to Lysandus's shame. This event was only preserved in a Parcel of Letters kept hidden deep beneath Castle Necromoghan.
The Knight of Emerald Princess is the ghost of a knight located in the Burial Mounds, Glenumbra, in .
The Knight of the Iron Son is the ghost of a knight located in the Burial Mounds, Glenumbra, in .
The Knight of the Golden Prince is the ghost of a knight located in the Burial Mounds, Glenumbra, in .

Kinlord Nemfarion is an Altmer residing in Corgrad Wastes, Summerset. He is the founder of the town of Corgrad and the leader of its ruling house. During the Thrassian Plague he ordered the city to be quarantined and eventually flooded it to prevent the disease from spreading.
Kinlady Taanwae is an Altmer residing in Corgrad Wastes, Summerset. She is a member of the ruling house of Corgrad.
Klumbert is a Bosmer located at Market-Side Meadery in Skywatch, Auridon, in . He is only present during the Jester's Festival event and wears a purple and gold evening suit.
Kovan Kren is a Dunmer Nightblade who can be found in the northeast corner of the main cave after purchasing the spymaster upgrade for Dunbarrow Cove from Dahlia Rackham for 1000 .

Kummu is a Dunmer Scout living in Erabenimsun Camp, in Morrowind. Kummu is a member of the Ashlanders and while she is not flagged as being essential, killing her may anger the tribe, which may affect the Main Quest.
Kushishi is a Dunmer herder and Ashlander residing in Erabenimsun Camp.

Kunthar is a Nord barbarian living in Pelagiad, Morrowind. He can be found wandering around town equipped for battle. Kunthar often takes a rest in the alley between Ahnassi's House and Uulernil: Armorer, providing a good opportunity to pickpocket his gold. He is not involved in any quests.

Ladia Flarugrius is an Imperial savant and Thieves Guild member living in Pelagiad, Morrowind. Ladia can be found upstairs at the Halfway Tavern, where she offers skill training and will purchase books from the Nerevarine even though she has no inventory of her own for sale. She is not involved in any quests.

Kylius Lonavo is a Dunmer Rogue, and skooma dealer working at the Greyland settlement just outside the walls of Leyawiin. Lonavo and his marauder compatriot are on the run from the Imperial Legion for dealing skooma. In the quest "Raid on Greyland," an Imperial Legion member named Lerexus Callidus recruits the Hero to go to Greyland and kill Lonavo. Callidius himself calls Lonavo "a snake" because of the way he has evaded capture. When attempting to kill Lonavo he wields an enchanted claymore, but if they succeed in killing him, take his ring to Callidius and he will give a leveled reward.

Kurdan gro-Dragol is an Orc money lender in Bravil. Besides, with a job as a usurer, he makes most of his money in what he calls the "Hunter's run" where people pay him to hunt living human prey. Those who fall too deep in debt risk the chance of being tricked into becoming prey in the hunt.
Lady Drad is a Dunmer and the wife of Lord Drad. She and her husband are forced into servitude after their ogre slaves were freed in Malacath's Daedric quest.
Krognak gro-Brok is a pirate that is a part of The Serpent's Wake crew. He resides at the The Fo'c's'le in Anvil.
Krosis (Dragon Language: Krosis, "") is one of the eight major Dragon Priests, and is typically found at the dragon lair of Shearpoint.
Kust is a Nord living in Falkreath. He is the keeper of Falkreath Graveyard and the assistant of Runil, and resides in the Hall of the Dead.

Korir is the Nord Jarl of Winterhold. He can be found in the Jarl's Longhouse in Winterhold. He is the father of Assur and husband of Thaena. He does not approve of the College of Winterhold, and his opinions are typically ignored by the other Jarls, due to Winterhold not being seen as one of the "important" holds in Skyrim. If banished from Winterhold, he will reside in Brunwulf Free-Winter's house in Windhelm with his family. Should the Imperials control Winterhold, Korir will be exiled and replaced by Kraldar.

One of the last few holdouts, Kraldar refuses to give up and move away from Winterhold. Kraldar is a pleasant sort, convinced that Winterhold will someday again be the shining jewel of Skyrim that it once was.

Kyr is a Nord bandit leader who plays a small part in the quest "The Pale Lady." Kyr's Log can be found in Frostmere Crypt, where the quest takes place. He wears steel armor, an iron war axe and a hide shield.

Krag was a Breton conjurer and a scholar of the Dwemer. His corpse can be found inside the Nchuand-Zel. His journal lies next to him. He went inside with Erj, Stromm and Staubin but all have been killed by the Falmer. Two corpses of Imperial soldiers can be found next to him.
Kurdan's Imperial Hunter is an Imperial hunter and one of three men who paid Kurdan gro-Dragol for the ability to hunt other humans and humanoids inside of Fort Grief.
Kurdan's Orc Hunter is an Orsimer hunter who was payed by Kurdan gro-Dragol to hunt humanoid prey. He holds the key to get out of Fort Grief, but it turns out to be a fake key.
Kvatch Soldier is an Imperial soldier in who appears during the main questline during the Battle of Bruma as one of the assembled forces from the cities of Cyrodiil.

Kund Assarnibani is a Dunmer Scout who is part of an minute Ashlanders tribe. He resides in Aidanat Camp just south of Ald Velothi in the West Gash on Vvardenfell, Morrowind. He acts as scout of his tribe and can be found outside of the only yurt in the camp.
Kyrnil Long-Nose was Harbinger of the Companions during the late Second Era.
Korst Wind-Eye is a Nord and the local shaman living in Skaal Village.
Krosulhah (Dragon Language: Kro–Sul–Hah, "Sorcerer–Day–") is a dragon in . He is found outside of Nchardak after completing "The Path of Knowledge."
Krazzt is a unique Dremora who can be found guarding the Shrine of Courtesy in the Puzzle Canal in Vivec City. He is a servant of the Daedra Lord Mehrunes Dagon.

King Kurog gro-Orsinium, also known as Chief Kurog gro-Bagrakh, is the Orcish King of Orsinium. Parts of Wrothgar are under the control of King Kurog, who emphasizes that the Orcs of Orsinium worship Trinimac instead of Malacath, out of the belief that the ways of Malacath are outdated, and that reinstating Trinimac as the Orcish deity is the path to unity and progression. Kurog is a member of the Daggerfall Covenant and represents the Orcs. However, his duties to uniting the Orcish clans and rebuilding Orsinium keep him occupied from the politics of the Three Banners War.
Lady Arannelya was an Altmer commander for the Third Aldmeri Dominion and for the main force of the Thalmor invasion into Hammerfell during the Great War.
Krastir is a Nord leatherworker. She sells her wares at her stall, War-Worthy Leathers, at the market district in Davon's Watch.
Kothon Bear-Master is a Nord carpenter. He works and sells his wares at the millworks in Daggerfall.
Laanestii is an Altmer stablemaster in who owns the Abecean Saddle Company in Vulkhel Guard. Laanestii's sister, Laanari, owns the Constellation Farms in Skywatch.
Kunira-daro is a Khajiit silk trader residing in Woodhearth.
Kurnasiran is a Khajiit member of the Mages Guild. He is found at their branch in Elden Root.
Kubiba-ma is a Khajiit residing in Redfur Trading Post in the region of Grahtwood.

Krin Ren-dro is a Khajiit and a former agent of the Eyes of the Queen. Following his defection, he settled in Pa'alat, where he began selling private information of the Aldmeri Dominion to the other alliances. Upon hearing this, Queen Ayrenn sent another Eye of the Queen named Cariel after him to put an end to his dealings.
Lady Clarisse Laurent is a Breton treasure hunter that could be found in various zones around her camp, usually accompanied by her servant and assistant Stibbons. She has a cat named Mistress Lamae.
Kushi is a Redguard residing in the Alik'r Camp, in Alcaire Castle. She's found tending the horses near Kardyn's Home.
Korthor is a Dragon Priest buried in Vuldngrav, where he guards the Fork of Horripilation.
Laanari is an Altmer stablemaster who owns the Constellation Farms in Skywatch. Her sister, Laanestii, owns the Abecean Saddle Company in Vulkhel Guard.

Lady Cinnabar is a Redguard member of the Mages Guild found inside the Imperial City Sewers. She is a rival of Phrastus of Elinhir, another scholar who is also found in the sewers. Both have published numerous books.
Kotholl Ironfist is a Nord mercenary that was hired by the merchants camping in the Obsidian Gorge.
Kurz gra-Murtag is an Orsimer warrior of the Fighters Guild residing in the guildhall in the city of Evermore.

Ladrelas is a Bosmer armorer and clothier initially residing in the city of Mistral, where he can be found at his stall, Iron Bark Plate and Mail. Following the restoration of the Hollow City, he will relocate there and open a stall at the Cold Iron Forge.
Lacherie Luluelle is a Breton residing in the city of Wayrest.
Lady Astrid Silane is a Breton noble found inside the castle in Evermore, Bangkorai.
Kozelan al-Kozanset is a Redguard residing in the city of Sentinel.
Kynreeve Erunas is a powerful Dremora trapped inside the talisman recovered from Merovec's Folly. Glenumbra, in .
Korsen Snow-Bourne is a Nord found inside his family home in Windhelm.
Kudleez is an Argonian member of the Ebonheart Pact found in Zuuk, Shadowfen.
Krogrash is an Orsimer commoner residing in the city of Port Hunding, Stros M'Kai.
Lady Edwyge is a Breton witch leading the coven found in the Rubble Butte.
Kyngogurth is a Dremora found in the Court of Contempt in Coldharbour.
Korgha is an Orsimer grocer who sells her wares in the town of Kerbol's Hollow, Bangkorai.

Krasdore is a Breton member of Captain Currod's crew found aboard The Tava's Bounty, which is docked in Koeglin Village. He has no unique dialogue, and can be found injured on the quarterdeck standing beside Carrod.
Krisandra Edrald is a Breton in . She and her husband Allan Edrald are the proprietors of the Edrald Estate, where they live with their daughter Arlie Edrald.
Ku'ah af-Perah is a Redguard noble attending to Count Hosni at-Tura's party at his estate.
Kunasheeth is an Argonian commoner found in Davon's Watch. She has no unique dialogue.
Kuralit is a Khajiit beggar found in Marbruk. If asked about his story, he has a lengthy and rather unlikely tale to tell.
Kurd is an Orsimer who can be found at the Evermore Outlaws Refuge.
Kurdi is a Khajiit soldier in the Dominion found at Eagle's Strand.
Kuzda is a Khajiit working at the Manor and Treasury in Vulkhel Guard.
Kuzulaza is a Khajiit found aboard The Blasted Breton in Alten Corimont.
Lady Adima is a Redguard noble and the wife of Count Hosni at-Tura. She is also the second-in-command of the Midnight Union.
Lady Aurine Tamrith is a Breton noble and the mother of Eselde and Janeve.

Lady Elanwe is an Altmer and the mistress of High Kinlord Rilis XII. She is worried about her son Sorondil's safety as he is trying to prove that he is a Rilis himself by challenging his ancestors at their family estate.
Kurzoth is a powerful Troll found inside Exarch's Stronghold. He accompanies Exarch Braadoth in combat.
Kululaza is a character residing in the town of Alten Corimont.
Kushorithi is a Redguard laborer residing in Daggerfall. She can be found listening to the announcements of Crier Martine, just outside the Daggerfall Millworks. She has no unique dialogue.
Kupkin is a tame, named banekin that resides in the city of Skywatch, on the second floor tower of the Skywatch Mages Guild, with Soothsayer Erralle.
Kraala Birdsong is a hagraven who resides in Coldperch Cavern.
Kyla Chaudry is a Breton who resides in the Deleyn's Mill village in Glenumbra. She is the daughter of Ronyssa Chaudry. She died during the siege on the village.
Kyrtos is a Reachman briarheart of the Winterborn Clan found within Honor's Rest.
Kothutuilk is a Dremora overseeing the soul shrivens slaves in The Black Forge.
Kyleus Herminia is an Imperial mage of the Imperial Legion. She is found in the Nobles District of the Imperial City.

Ladia Rose is an Imperial and the proprietor of The Withered Rose, an hostel situated near Anvil. She works as the barkeep while her daughter Lucinia tends to the livestock and crops outside. She cannot be interacted with.

Kulan-dro is a Khajiit moon priest. Prior to the Dro-m'Athra invasion, he was the abbot of the Temple of Seven Riddles. Kulan-dro will follow the Vestige throughout the temple before finally succumbing to the corruption. He will then transform into Rakkhat, a Grievous Twilight, and becoming hostile.
Kunamu-la is a Khajiit of the Baandari Clan. She is found at their caravan settled in Kozanset.
Kradauk gro-Shuhgharz is an Orsimer blacksmith residing in Martyr's Crossing, Bangkorai. He can be found at his stall, Crossed Arms Smithy, selling his wares.
Kotu Gava Broodmother is a mosquito-like creature in . Kotu Gava Broodmothers are most often seen in Hew's Bane region of Hammerfell.
Kroma kra-Magla is an Orsimer member of the Agra Crun residing in the city of Orsinium.
Krzztrrb is a Dremora home goods furnisher. He is found in the Hollow City and Belkarth.
Kothheid is a Nord encountered as a mini-boss in the Maelstrom Arena.
Kura is a Dunmer Ashlander fisher residing in Urshilaku Camp on Vvardenfell. He has no unique dialogue.
Kythiirix is a Spider Daedra that can be found in Tusenend in . She is standing in a chamber across the corridor with steam and lava, in front of the Molag Bal statue.
Kra'gh the Dreugh King is a dreugh in . He is the final boss of Fungal Grotto I.
Kott is a Nord found at the southern part of the Shimmerene Dockworks in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. He has no unique dialogue.
Krithgra is an Orsimer found within the Undercroft Great Hall of the Monastery of Serene Harmony in Shimmerene. She has no unique dialogue.
Kuhlon is an Orsimer explorer located in the mountain of Sorrow. After finishing dialogue with her, she will die.
Lady Belain is a Breton keep-witch residing in Understone Keep who serves as chief advisor to Ard Caddach.
Lady Bridwell is a noblewoman and the wife of Lord Bridwell in .
Kud-Mere is an Argonian fence who runs the storefront Fence and Fens at the Lilmoth Outlaws Refuge in Lilmoth.
Lady Arabelle is a Breton residing in Lady Arabelle's Camp in Vvardenfell.
Lady Circone is a Bosmer residing in the Slag Town Outlaws Refuge.
Lanabi is a Dunmer Trader living in her yurt in Ahemmusa Camp in Vvardenfell's Grazelands. She is an Ashlanders with the rank of Hearthfriend, belonging to the tribe of the Ahemmusa Ashlanders.

Lakvan was a bandit leader and lackey of Jagar Tharn. He worked closely with Pergan Asuul, a union that even Jagar Tharn himself didn't like. Skyrim and Hammerfell both distrusted him, as he was used by the Imperials in an attempt to gain power in Hammerfell. He used a Daedric battle axe and held a Shadowkey. The mysterious Hero of Azra's Crossing defeated him and his band of bandits at his stronghold, along with Pergan Asuul's second incarnation.
Larrius Varro is an Imperial warrior residing at the Moonmoth Legion Fort. He dislikes the corruption that has taken root in Balmora.
Largakh gro-Bulfim is an Orsimer member of the Imperial Legion in .
Lathon (or Sir Lathon if knighted) is a Redguard, and is Sir Roderic's squire.
Landorume is an Altmer Agent living in the Hawkmoth Legion Garrison in Ebonheart. In addition to his trading services, he is also a member of the Imperial Legion.
Lalatia Varian is an Imperial living in Ebonheart. She is second only to Ruccia Conician and is the one to give all the later Imperial Cult quests to the Nerevarine.
Lalaine Essagan is an Imperial smuggler who resides in the Dwemer Ruins of Arkngthand.
Larienna Macrina is an Imperial who resides in Morrowind. She is a crusader on the hunt for a Daedroth named Hrelvesuu.

Larisus Dergius is a hostile Imperial warrior and bandit who resides in Yasamsi. He lives there together with three other smugglers, Dudley, Ralos Othrenim, and Thervam Drelas. He is one of the murderer of Julielle Aumine.

Lami is a Nord and adept-level alchemist from Morthal. She can be found in the Thaumaturgist's Hut in Morthal, where she is the shopkeeper. Here she lives with her husband Jorgen in their house across the bridge by the wood mill.
Laila Law-Giver is a Nord in who, as Jarl of Riften, resides with her court in Mistveil Keep, where she holds court.
Lash gra-Dushnikh is an Orsimer miner residing in the village of Karthwasten.
Laenafil is a Bosmer warrior who can be found patrolling the lower level of Fort Sutch. She appears there after starting the quest "Bad Medicine."

Langley is an Imperial and the Guard Captain in Anvil. He remarks on how the crime is so light that he and the rest of the guard have little work. However, Countess Umbranox feels differently and has been looking for a replacement from the Imperial City.
Larthjar the Laggard is a Nord who can be found in the Skingrad Castle Dungeon. He was arrested and imprisoned in the Dungeon for assaulting a young woman.
Lashana was a Redguard who was sent to the Forsaken Mine to clear it from trolls, along with fellow Fighters Guild members.
Lassour Zenammu is a Dunmer residing in Ald'ruhn. He is a member of the Morag Tong.
Lassnr is a Nord barbarian who resides in the Skaal Village.
Lanie Endre was a Breton bard who may be found dead in the area around Shishi, killed by members of House Redoran in response to House Telvanni setting up an outpost at Shishi.
Lagabesh is an Orsimer child and the daughter of Ugarlesh, who resides on the island of Betnikh.
Lambug gra-Lurn is an Orsimer agent residing in the stronghold of Valenvaryon in the Ashlands.
Lady Eloise Noellaume is a Breton noble held hostage with her husband in their house by Red Rook Bandits in . After the Vestige has rescued her and the others, she admits she was terrified.
Lagarg is an Orsimer merchant residing in Port Hunding and found in the local inn, the Screaming Mermaid where he sells a variety of groceries.
Lagabul is an Orsimer residing in Stonetooth Fortress, Betnikh. She has a stall just outside the Stonetooth Fortress, selling the usual items a merchant has to offer.
Laganakh is an Orsimer residing in Stonetooth Fortress, Betnikh.
Lady Rielle is a Breton residing in Aldcroft, Glenumbra. She and her husband, Duke Sebastien, are hiding in a house in Aldcroft.
Lagrog Guillon is an Orsimer who resides in Daggerfall, Glenumbra. He can be found walking in town, reading a book.
Laryaril is an Altmer member of the Aldmeri Dominion and Thalmor found wounded inside the Imperial Underground beneath Woodhearth. Laryaril is the twin sister of Asteril.
Laerion is a Bosmer residing in Bramblebreach in the region of Greenshade, who has a fascination with ants.
